text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said in a draft 1998 budget proposal on Tuesday that it plans GDP in 1997 to be 36.6 billion litas and 42.31 billion litas in 1998.
It also plans 1998 inflation of six percent and national budget revenues of 8.8 billion litas.
The draft also plans 9.4 billion litas spending in the national budget in 1998.
The finance ministry also plans that the state budget deficit should not exceed 600 million litas in 1998, 67 million litas less than in 1997.
The planned deficit would be 1.4 percent of GDP in 1998 compared with 1.9 percent in 1997, the ministry added.
It also suggested to cover the 1998 deficit by issuing government T-bills.
The draft proposal is expected to be submitted for the cabinet to discuss and possibly approve on Wednesday.
